symptom: Catalog entries without a published snapshot exposed the metric definition ID as latest_snapshot.snapshot_id.
root_cause: The LEFT JOIN row exists even when metric_snapshots has no match, and publicSnapshot fell back from snapshot_id to the definition row id.
generic_fix: Return latest_snapshot null unless the joined snapshot_id is present.
regression: Synthetic two-tenant test covers absence and presence of a published snapshot without customer fixtures.
